gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_archiefguh: Find the pages of a very old diary.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_grenswacht: Put your village's moved boundary posts back.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_lichtpuntj: Find out who makes light in the cellar at night.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_schatbewaa: Find what lay under the oldest little tree.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_speurneus: Solve your first little case with Sherlock Guh in The Inheritance.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.sherlock_spokenjage: Find out what's haunting the old shed.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_begin.bewe: Your Honor! The land was sold for one nibble. One nibble is not a REAL price! The sale is invalid!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_begin.open: Silence in the court! The neighboring village's courtroom is now in session.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_begin.wakk: Zzz... huh? Has it started already? Sniffer, you're up.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_begin.zaak: Today: The Great Nibble Case. Morris-Mika versus the new owner of Grandpa Nibble's homestead. Munch.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar1.b: That will is fake! It isn't even signed!
Grandpa Nibble's will: 'My homestead goes to whoever takes good care of it, for the price of one nibble.' It was his wish!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar1.t: Objection sustained! A nibble is a perfectly fine price. Munch.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar2.b: But that nibble was made of PLASTIC! So nobody ever really paid!
The last page, found under the oldest little tree! Signed with Grandpa Nibble's pawprint!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar2.r: That... that is a veeery convincing little paw.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar2.t: Sustained! A real pawprint. What an adorable little paw. Munch.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.b: The cheese nibble itself! With Realtor Guhrrit's tiny tooth mark. He just had to taste whether it was real, didn't he?
A... Little Nibble Parking? For me? ...Flowers are actually kind of okay.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.h: (He takes a bite out of his cheese nibble gavel.) Mmm.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.k: But my nephews, the chicken thieves... they are a lot less nice. Keep a good eye on your eggs. Hehe.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.p: Then why not just take a spot at our place? One parking space. With a flower box.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.t: Sustained! You can't taste a plastic nibble. This one is real. I had a little taste too. Munch.
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.u: Verdict: the homestead stays with whoever takes good care of it. Court adjourned!
scene.guhs.sherlock_rechtbank_bezwaar3.z: Sigh... You know, all I really wanted was somewhere to park my own little cart.
sherlock.beloning.bertha_optreden: Bertha the Cow now performs at village parties!
sherlock.beloning.bureau_eindlook: Your Detective Agency gets its finest look!
sherlock.beloning.oma_bestelling: Granny Knitguh now orders from you often, with a little extra on top.
sherlock.beloning.opas_kelder: Grandpa's cellar is now a cozy room in your Homestead, with spots for your finds!
sherlock.beloning.paaltjes_terug: Pete straightens all the boundary posts again, bows and all. Your village is exactly as big as always again! To say sorry, he slips you his nicest little carrot. Nyeg.
sherlock.beloning.recept_theetaartje: The Bakery now knows the recipe for the tea tart!
sherlock.beloning.testament: Grandpa Nibble's will is complete, with the last page!
sherlock.bericht.alles_gevonden: All clue cards found! Go to the clue board in the Detective Agency and point out the culprit.
sherlock.bericht.glas: You get Sherlock's magnifying glass. Hold it in your village during a case: the clues will sparkle!
sherlock.bericht.klaar: There's a new little case in the Detective Agency's mailbox: %s! %s
sherlock.bericht.pet: You get Sherlock's checkered cap (the Guhlock Cap) for your guhs!
sherlock.bericht.sticker: Sticker in your Sniffer's Notebook: First try!
sherlock.bericht.wacht: %s has to wait a bit. First: %s.
sherlock.bord.fout.0: Hmm, that doesn't quite add up. Take another good look at the clue cards!
sherlock.bord.fout.1: No problem! A real sniffer simply tries again.
sherlock.bord.fout.2: Sherlock mumbles in his sleep: 'cold... colder...' Try someone else!
sherlock.bord.haring: Wait a minute... this clue card doesn't fit: %s. I've turned it red. Take that string off!
sherlock.bord.te_weinig: Pin at least three clue cards on %s first, sniffer. Otherwise nobody will believe us.
sherlock.cmd.alles_klaar: All cases have already been solved!
sherlock.cmd.geen_zaak: There's no case running right now.
sherlock.getuige.klaar: Thanks for stopping by, sniffer! I've already told you everything.
sherlock.glas.alles: All clues found! Ask the witnesses, or go to the clue board.
sherlock.glas.grap.0: This is grass. Very suspicious grass.
sherlock.glas.grap.1: You see... your own nose. Magnified.
sherlock.glas.grap.2: An ant! Oh no, a crumb. Oh no, an ant with a crumb.
sherlock.glas.grap.3: Nothing to see. Just lots and lots of chonk.
sherlock.glas.grap.4: Hmm. This pebble looks guilty. But there's no case.
sherlock.glas.grap.5: Without a case, a magnifying glass is just a very round little window.
sherlock.glas.heet: Very warm! Something is close by. Look at it and try again.
sherlock.glas.koud: Cold. Brrr. Try looking somewhere else in the village.
sherlock.glas.niet_hier: Nothing to sniff out here. The clues are in your own village.
sherlock.glas.warm: Warm... the clues aren't far away.
sherlock.guhrrit.0: Structural report: chonky. Emotional report: very chonky.
sherlock.guhrrit.1: One cheese nibble for a whole homestead. A bargain! I'd take it myself, if I weren't so busy.
sherlock.guhrrit.2: I've always said it: this is a fixer-upper. With the emphasis on upper!
sherlock.guhrrit.3: Just look at that view. Well, right now it's nettles. But they'll bloom soon!
sherlock.guhrrit.4: I'm off on vacation soon. I'll send you a postcard. With sunshine on it!
sherlock.guhrrit.5: Paperwork? All sorted! I put a little squiggle under everything.
sherlock.klik.ander: Hello! I help this village's sniffer. Your own little cases are in your own village, nyeg.
sherlock.klik.morris: Move aside, move aside. Time is asphalt.
sherlock.klik.oehoe: Hoo, hoo. I'm guarding something here. What exactly? That's a secret. Whoo knows.
sherlock.klik.pim: Hi! Wanna see my little carrots? They're growing super fast. A little bit.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.guhrrit: What an exciting case! Structural report of this courtroom: chonky.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.morris: Hmph. Just wait until the judge hears me out.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.oehoe: Hoo, hoo. I'm guarding the witness stand.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.oma: I'm knitting a little scarf for the judge, sweetie. He's cold under his wig.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.pim: I'm so nervous. I've already petted my little carrot three times.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.rechter: Silence in the court! ...Well, you may whisper.
sherlock.klik.rechtbank.vadson: I'm writing everything down! Even that the judge is eating his gavel.
sherlock.optie.toon: Take a look at this clue...
sherlock.proloog.0: Something glints among the nettles: a rusty little key, with a teeny cheese as a charm.
sherlock.proloog.1: What could it belong to? You put it in your Finds Box. Maybe someone will know later...
sherlock.rechtbank.bewering.1: The land was sold for one nibble. One nibble is not a REAL price! So the sale is invalid!
sherlock.rechtbank.bewering.2: That will is fake! It isn't even signed!
sherlock.rechtbank.bewering.3: That nibble was made of plastic! So nobody ever really paid!
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.glimmend_knoopje: A button belonging to Mr. Morris. Glad it's back. But it proves nothing.
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.kaasknabbel: A nibble! Yummy. But that's not what this is about yet. Munch?
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.laatste_bladzijd: A signature, how lovely. But that's not what this question is about.
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.rood_veertje: A feather? What does a feather have to do with this? It is a lovely red, though.
sherlock.rechtbank.fout.testament: We've already seen the will, sniffer. Something else, please.
sherlock.rechtbank.hint.1: Psst... what did Grandpa Nibble say in his will again? About the price?
sherlock.rechtbank.hint.2: Psst... a signature. What did we find under the oldest little tree again?
sherlock.rechtbank.hint.3: Psst... plastic? Who was it that took a little taste of that nibble again?
sherlock.rechtbank.kies: Sniffer, show your best evidence! Pick it from your clue board.
sherlock.rechtbank.terug: Court adjourned. Want to go home, sniffer? Or look around a bit more?
sherlock.rechtbank.thuis: You're back home. The village stays yours. And from now on, Morris parks very neatly in his Little Nibble Parking.
sherlock.rechtbank.welkom: You're in the neighboring village's courtroom. Everyone is here!
sherlock.ui.proloog.ja: Prologue: a rusty little key with a tiny cheese
sherlock.ui.testament.tekst: My homestead goes to whoever takes good care of it, for the price of one nibble. Not to anyone in a necktie. (Grandpa Nibble)
sherlock.ui.uitleg: Click a clue card, then a suspect: that pins a red string. Right-click a clue card to unpin it. Three strings on one suspect? Accuse!
sherlock.ui.uitleg_kies: You're holding '%s'. Now click a suspect.
sherlock.ui.uitleg_rood: Chonkson turned a clue card red: it doesn't fit. Remove the string (right-click) or pin it somewhere else.
sherlock.ui.uitleg_verzamel: Talk to all the witnesses in your village. Each statement gets pinned here, next to the will.
sherlock.vadson.klaar: There's a new little case in the mailbox! Take a look in the Sniffer's Notebook!
sherlock.vadson.rust: No case right now. I'm reading through my Sniffer's Notebook again. So exciting!
sherlock.vadson.tip.bord: We have everything! Pin three clue cards on one suspect on the clue board and point out the culprit.
sherlock.vadson.tip.getuige: All clues found! But %s surely knows something more. Go and ask!
sherlock.vadson.tip.sporen: We're still missing %s clue(s). Hold the magnifying glass and walk around: whatever sparkles is a clue!
sherlock.welkom.0: Good afternoon! Sherlock Guh, famous sniffer. I say so myself, but it's also true. Nyeg.
sherlock.welkom.1: And I'm Doctor Chonkson! I write everything down in the Sniffer's Notebook. EVERYTHING. Even what we have for lunch.
sherlock.welkom.2: This village smells of mystery. And of cookies. Mostly of mystery... zzz...
sherlock.welkom.3: He's asleep. He does that a lot. Here, take his magnifying glass. Hold it in your village and the clues will sparkle!
sherlock.welkom.4: As soon as there's a little case, it'll be in the agency's mailbox. Wahoog, how exciting!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.fout.makelaar: (A postcard from the sunshine:) 'Me? I'm lying on the beach, darling! But keep a good eye on your things, okay!'
sherlock.zaak.blikje.fout.morris: Yes, I was here. I slipped. My button came off. But the tin was already empty! Hmph.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.fout.pim: Me? I only dig for little carrots! And those don't come in tins.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.getuige.pim.gezien: I saw Hoo-hoo fly off with something white in her beak! Right after that, Morris came with a shovel. He slipped. Hehe.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.getuige.pim.hallo: Hi sniffer! I'm your informant now. I even have an informant hat. Well, a little bucket.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.getuige.pim.toon: Oh! That button is Morris's. He was really cross about it. He only has six left.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.getuige.pim.waar: In my veggie patch. My little carrots are already sooo big. Wanna see them?
sherlock.zaak.blikje.intro.0: Under the oldest little tree you dig up an old cheese tin. You open the lid...
sherlock.zaak.blikje.intro.1: EMPTY?! The tin is empty! Someone got here before us!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.intro.2: An empty tin is a tin with nothing in it, Chonkson. There is a thief. Or a kind someone. Search, sniffer.
From Realtor Guhrrit, on vacation: 'Keep a good eye on your things, okay!'
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.glimmend_knoo: A button from a shiny suit. Morris's! He's been here!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.iets_wits.tek: Pete saw Hoo-hoo fly off with something white in her beak. Just before Morris came to dig.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.nesttakje: A nest twig with paper scraps
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.nesttakje.tek: A twig from a nest, with a little scrap of old paper stuck to it.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kaart.veertjes_boom: Owl feathers by the little tree
More feathers. Soft and downy. Someone landed here.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.kort: Under the oldest little tree you dig up an old cheese tin. But it's empty!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.0: Hoo, hoo many times do I have to say it? I GUARD things.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.1: When that Mika came digging, I hid the page in my little nest. Here. It's yours.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.2: The last page! With Grandpa Nibble's signature! A little pawprint!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.3: As I said. We have everything. Now all we need is... zzz...
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.4: Then a red letter drops into the mailbox. The envelope says: SUMMONS.
sherlock.zaak.blikje.oplossing.5: Morris-Mika is taking us to court! Sniffer, we have to prepare our case!
sherlock.zaak.blikje.titel: The Tin Under the Little Tree
sherlock.zaak.eieren.fout.eendje: Quack?! Quack quack! (The little duck is deeply offended and swims an angry little lap.)
sherlock.zaak.eieren.fout.pim: Me? I can't even lift an egg, nyeg. I was only by the gate because the flowers there are so pretty...
sherlock.zaak.eieren.getuige.bonnie.gezi: At night I heard someone sighing by the pond. Very romantic sighing. And someone whispering 'cock-a-doodle-doo'. Very softly.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.getuige.bonnie.hall: Sniffer! Are you here about the eggs? I see everything, you know. EVERYTHING.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.getuige.bonnie.toon: Oh, I know that! I've seen that already. I see everything, remember?
sherlock.zaak.eieren.getuige.bonnie.waar: Me? I was in my little bed, with one eye open. Like always. That's why I see everything.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.intro.0: Sherlock! SHERLOCK! The Chicken Coop hasn't laid a single egg in two days!
sherlock.zaak.eieren.intro.1: Hmm. No eggs. That is... eggless. Egg-stremely suspicious.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.intro.2: Sniffer, take the magnifying glass and search around the Chicken Coop. Meanwhile I'll think very hard. With my eyes closed.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.intro.3: And ask Farmer Bonnie what she saw! She sees everything. Really everything. It's a little spooky.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kaart.bonnie_zuchte: Bonnie heard someone sighing at night. 'Very romantic sighing', she says.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kaart.hartjesschaal: Someone drew a little heart on it. With a beak, by the look of it. How romantic, nyeg!
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kaart.pootafdrukjes: Three little toes, heading for the Duck Pond. Someone was hopping along very happily here.
A feather! A FEATHER, Sherlock! And a red one, too. Which chicken is red?
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kaart.stagiairspasj: A badge from Morris-Mika Property Development. What was Pete doing at our gate?
sherlock.zaak.eieren.kort: The Chicken Coop hasn't produced any eggs for two days. Where did they go?
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.0: Henry the Rooster?! But why would a rooster take eggs?
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.1: Follow the little footprints to the reeds, Chonkson. As I said... zzz... romance.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.2: In the reeds by the pond lies a huge heart made of eggs. Next to it sits a little duck, with very big eyes.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.3: Cock-a-doodle-doo means 'I love you' in Duck. I think.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.4: How sweet! And look, under the heart there's an old tag: 'Property of Grandpa Nibble'...
sherlock.zaak.eieren.oplossing.5: Grandpa Nibble? Who is Grandpa Nibble? I'll write it down. With a question mark. A BIG question mark.
sherlock.zaak.eieren.wacht: build the Detective Agency (available from Homestead level 3)
sherlock.zaak.kelder.fout.morris: Me? Make evidence disappear? I just left my card lying around. By accident. On purpose. By accident.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.fout.pim: I can't read in the dark at all! And I'm scared of cellars. And of diaries.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.getuige.oehoe.gezie: I was asleep. Owls sleep during the day, you know. But I did hear lots of nibbling. Nibble nibble, all day long.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.getuige.oehoe.hallo: Hoo, hoo... yawn. You're waking me up, sniffer.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.getuige.oehoe.toon: Hoo... that smells of carrot. And of hay.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.getuige.oehoe.waar: In my little nest above the hatch. Where else? Whoo knows.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.intro.0: Hoo, hoo! The carrots are gone. The hatch opens. Come on in, sniffer.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.intro.1: Under the little shed lies a cozy old cheese cellar. On a little table lies a thick diary: 'Grandpa Nibble'.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.intro.2: His diary! But look... the last pages have been torn out!
sherlock.zaak.kelder.intro.3: Torn. That is the opposite of glued. Find the pages, sniffer.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.geknabbelde_r: The edges aren't torn. They've been nibbled! By tiny little teeth.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.knabbel_knabb: Hoo-hoo was asleep. But she did hear lots of nibbling. Nibble nibble, all day long.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.papier_in_ren: Paper clumps in the Bunny Run
